Display the configuration in effect.

Prints every setting as YAML after applying the precedence flag, then SLIPWAY_* environment variable, then configuration file, then built-in default. The first line names the configuration file that was consulted and says so when it does not exist.

Examples:
  # Show the settings in effect
  slipway config view

  # Show the settings another file would give
  slipway config view --config ~/work/slipway.yaml

Usage:
  slipway config view

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
